_purpose: HCAI Cal-Mortgage Loan Insurance Program cascade activity — bondholder claim payment events, new pipeline defaults, and HFCLIF (Health Facility Construction Loan Insurance Fund) reserve drawdowns. Trailing 18 months from as_of_date.
_data_quality_caveat: Most recent Monthly Activity Report publicly available is for period ending June 30, 2025 (published October 2025). Reports for July 2025 through May 2026 were not located in this session — best-faith interpretation is that HCAI publication cadence has slipped or 2026 reports are not yet on the public site. The cascade picture from June 2025 still falls within the trailing-18-month window from as_of_date 2026-05-28.

claim_payment_events_trailing_18mo.evidence: St. Rose Hospital (loan 1096) appears in the May 31, 2025 and June 30, 2025 Monthly Report 'Estimated HFCLIF Balance — OBLIGATIONS TO CAL-MORTGAGE: Anticipated Recoveries' table at $13,957,324 / $13,957,324 respectively. The same loan was identified in the Oliver Wyman 2024 Actuarial Study (as of 6/30/2024) 'Summary of Defaulted Loans - Current or in Pipeline' as a Pipeline Default with Financial Performance Problems, $29,077,178 case reserve at 100% probability of payment. The transition from pipeline-only (June 2024) to formally anticipated-recovery line item (May 2025) indicates Cal-Mortgage stepped in to satisfy a debt-service event in early 2025.

Pipeline Default WITH 100% probability of payment as of 6/30/2024. This was the load-bearing pre-cascade signal; the May 2025 Monthly Report confirms the cascade activated — loan 1096 anticipated recovery line for $13.96M is the post-payment book-entry.

hfclif_drawdown_interpretation: HFCLIF cash dropped ~$11.0M from Oct 31, 2024 to Jun 30, 2025 — consistent with payment on the St. Rose Hospital pipeline default plus operating expenses, with no offsetting premium revenue (June 2025 report shows $0 premiums collected). The wrap is still intact (HFCLIF ~$127.8M cash; net-of-recoveries balance ~$160.1M; $75M statutory minimum capital + $10.4M contingency reserve well-covered), but the cascade is real and ongoing.

_note_on_event_dating: HCAI Monthly Reports do not disclose precise claim payment dates; the timing of a payment is inferred from the month-of-first-appearance in the Anticipated Recoveries table. For severity-laddering purposes the detector uses the inferred event date, with the explicit caveat surfaced in evidence.
